`context="module"` is deprecated, use the `module` attribute instead
https://svelte.dev/e/script_context_deprecated

Using `on:move:start` to listen to the move:start event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `onmove:start` instead
https://svelte.dev/e/event_directive_deprecated

Using `on:move` to listen to the move event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `onmove` instead
https://svelte.dev/e/event_directive_deprecated

Using `on:move:stop` to listen to the move:stop event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `onmove:stop` instead
https://svelte.dev/e/event_directive_deprecated
